title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
authors: Ge Yan, Shanchuan Li, Pengyue Ma, Qixin Zhang, Pingchuan Ma, Jianping Wang, Min-Hsiu Hsieh, Yuxuan Du
publish: arXiv
abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, discovering QEC codes that remain effective is challenging, as logical performance depends on the interplay between code structure, hardware, syndrome extraction, and decoding, which often impose competing requirements. Here we introduce OmniQEC, an efficient AI scientist for discovering QEC codes suited to deployment on modern quantum processors. OmniQEC formulates QEC design as an iterative discovery process in which an orchestrator, implemented by advanced large language models (LLMs), coordinates code generation, code-level screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation. At its core, OmniQEC combines a self-evolving reasoning mechanism with a slow--fast synergistic workflow: a fast loop explores candidates using inexpensive code-level proxies, whereas a slow loop performs physically grounded circuit-level evaluation and feeds the resulting evidence back into the search. We evaluate OmniQEC across four qLDPC construction families, three LLM backends, and $14$ total-physical-qubit budgets per backend. The discovered codes show steadily improving logical-error suppression with increasing physical-qubit budgets and outperform the BB codes with $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ and $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ under complete-implementation budgets of 98 and 240 physical qubits, respectively. The discovered codes are hardware-friendly and may be of independent interest for practical QEC implementation. These findings pave the way towards LLM-assisted QEC discovery grounded in physically informed code--circuit--decoder co-design.
title_zh: OmniQEC：AI科学家发现实用量子纠错码
abstract_zh: 量子纠错（QEC）是实现可扩展容错量子计算不可或缺的技术。然而，发现保持有效的QEC码极具挑战性，因为其逻辑性能取决于码结构、硬件、纠错子提取和解码之间的相互作用，而这些因素往往存在相互冲突的要求。本文介绍OmniQEC——一种高效的人工智能科学工具，专为发现适合部署在现代量子处理器上的量子纠错码而设计。OmniQEC将QEC设计形式化为一个迭代发现过程：由先进的大语言模型（LLMs）实现的协调器负责统筹代码生成、码级筛选、纠错子提取综合以及基于解码器的电路评估。其核心创新在于将自演化推理机制与慢-快协同工作流相结合：快速循环通过廉价的码级代理探索候选方案，而慢速循环则执行基于物理基础的电路级评估，并将所得证据反馈至搜索过程。我们借助四个qLDPC（量子低密度奇偶校验码）构造族、三种大语言模型后端以及每种后端对应的14个总物理量子比特预算来评估OmniQEC。结果显示，所发现的码随着物理量子比特预算增加展现出逻辑错误抑制能力的稳步提升，并且在98和240个物理量子比特的完全实现预算下，分别以$[\![72,12,6]\!]$和$[\![144,12,12]\!]$的参数超越了BB码族。这些发现的码具有硬件友好特性，可能对实际QEC实现具有独立研究价值。这些成果为基于物理信息驱动的码-电路-解码器协同设计的LLM辅助量子纠错发现铺平了道路。

title: A Control System, a Dataset, and a Recipe for Making Frozen LLM Agents Learn a Domain
authors: Debjyoti Paul
publish: arXiv
abstract: Production LLM agents are increasingly assembled from a frozen model wrapped in a harness: a prompt template, a tool set, a memory/retrieval layer, a planning strategy, and a verification policy. Two 2026 systems, Meta-Harness (Lee et al., 2026) and HyperAgents (Meta AI, 2026), show that this harness can itself be optimized or even self-rewritten by an agentic proposer -- at the cost of either an expensive code-search loop or unconstrained self-modifying code, neither of which is auditable or usable with a fully black-box model API. We take a narrower, more constrained position: treat the harness as a small, fixed, human-legible action space and learn a policy over it online with classic sample-efficient reinforcement learning (an $ε$-greedy contextual bandit and REINFORCE), scored against a multi-objective reward (task success, verifier score, policy compliance, cost, latency, and an unsupported-claim penalty). We instantiate this control system with DSPy (Khattab et al., 2024) as both the context assembler and the source of the strongest non-adaptive baseline (a DSPy BootstrapFewShot static prompt), and evaluate it across three verifiable task domains -- tool-use workflows, code generation (HumanEval), and multi-hop retrieval QA (HotpotQA) -- and two model providers (a local Ollama model and AWS Bedrock). We release the harness-control-system code, the cross-domain verifiable task suite, the full trajectory/reward-decomposition logs from training, and a provider-agnostic deployment recipe for applying this to a new organization's domain and verification setup.
title_zh: 一个控制系统、一个数据集，以及让冻结的大语言模型代理学习某个领域的方法。
abstract_zh: 生产级的LLM智能体越来越多地由一个被封装在操控框架中的冻结模型组装而成：该框架包含提示模板、工具集、记忆/检索层、规划策略和验证策略。两个2026年的系统——Meta-Harness（Lee等，2026）和HyperAgents（Meta AI，2026）——表明这个操控框架本身可以被一个智能提议者优化甚至自我重写，但代价是昂贵的代码搜索循环或不受约束的自我修改代码，这两种方式都不可审计，也无法与完全黑盒模型API一起使用。我们采取一种更狭隘、更受约束的立场：将操控框架视为一个小的、固定的、人类可读的动作空间，并通过经典的样本高效强化学习（ε-贪心上下文强盗和REINFORCE）在线学习一个策略，根据多目标奖励（任务成功、验证器得分、策略合规性、成本、延迟和未支持声明的惩罚）进行评分。我们使用DSPy（Khattab等，2024）实例化这个控制系统，既作为上下文组装器，也作为最强非自适应基线（DSPy BootstrapFewShot静态提示）的来源，并在三个可验证任务领域——工具使用工作流、代码生成（HumanEval）和多跳检索问答（HotpotQA）——以及两个模型提供商（本地Ollama模型和AWS Bedrock）上对其进行评估。我们发布了操控框架控制系统代码、跨域可验证任务套件、训练过程中的完整轨迹/奖励分解日志，以及一个与提供商无关的部署方案，用于将其应用到新组织的领域和验证设置中。

title: COVENANT: Natural-Language Workflow Compilation for Aligned Agent Execution
authors: Jincheng Wang, Min Zheng, Tao Wei
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly entrusted with natural-language workflow instructions (e.g., retail-payment policies) that specify not only what outcome to achieve, but also which steps, branches, and tool interactions are permitted. When these instructions are supplied as prompt context, however, the model retains control over both procedure selection and step execution. As interactions accumulate, an agent can skip required steps, take unsupported branches, or execute a valid step with unsupported arguments or effects--a failure mode we call workflow misalignment. In this work, we propose COVENANT, a compiler-and-interpreter architecture for workflow-aligned agent execution. Our key insight is to treat workflow instructions as source programs rather than prompts. COVENANT converts the instructions into a workflow abstract syntax tree (WAST) and lowers it to a workflow control-flow graph (WCFG). At runtime, a controller interprets the WCFG one node at a time, checks each proposal against requirements extracted from the instructions before committing controller state or advancing the graph, and returns diagnostic feedback for repair. To evaluate COVENANT, we use 120 cases from three existing benchmarks, spanning seven workflow scenarios. Compared with state-of-the-art LLM agents, COVENANT improves benchmark success from 50.00% to 83.33% and reduces the workflow-misalignment failure rate from 42.50% to 15.83% (62.75% relative). These results show that COVENANT substantially mitigates workflow misalignment, moving LLM-agent alignment beyond isolated prompt following toward reliable execution of complex and multi-step workflows.
title_zh: COVENANT：面向对齐智能体执行的自然语言工作流编译
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益被委以自然语言的工作流指令（例如零售支付政策），这些指令不仅规定了要实现的结果，还明确了允许执行的步骤、分支和工具交互。然而，当这些指令作为提示上下文提供时，模型仍保留对流程选择和步骤执行的控制权。随着交互的累积，智能体可能会跳过必要步骤、进入不支持的分支，或使用不支持的参数或效果执行有效步骤——我们将这种失败模式称为工作流失配。在本工作中，我们提出COVENANT，一种面向工作流对齐智能体执行的编译器与解释器架构。我们的核心洞察是将工作流指令视为源程序而非提示。COVENANT将指令转换为工作流抽象语法树（WAST），并将其降级为工作流控制流图（WCFG）。在运行时，控制器逐个节点地解释WCFG，在提交控制器状态或推进图之前，根据从指令中提取的要求检查每个提案，并返回诊断反馈用于修复。为评估COVENANT，我们使用来自三个现有基准测试的120个案例，涵盖七种工作流场景。与最先进的LLM智能体相比，COVENANT将基准测试成功率从50.00%提升至83.33%，并将工作流失配失败率从42.50%降低至15.83%（相对降低62.75%）。这些结果表明，COVENANT显著缓解了工作流失配，使LLM智能体的对齐从孤立的提示遵循迈向复杂多步骤工作流的可靠执行。

title: ContractHIL-HLS: Contract-Aligned Multi-Agent Workflow with Hardware-in-the-Loop Feedback for HLS Design
authors: Jingbo Zhang, Haoxiang Sun, Wenbo Wang, Wenbo Zhang
publish: arXiv
abstract: This paper presents ContractHIL-HLS, a contract-aligned multi-agent workflow for practical high-level synthesis (HLS) engineering. The workflow makes three contributions. First, it introduces a structured contract as the semantic-alignment and task-execution artifact that translates natural language requirements into explicit interfaces, constraints, validation checks, and rollback rules. Second, it incorporates hardware information into the feedback loop by feeding HLS, Vivado, PYNQ runtime, power, and failure evidence back into generation, thereby extending LLM-assisted HLS from kernel code toward system- and board-level closure. Third, it decomposes agents by semantic lowering and execution tasks rather than by conversational roles: a Contract Agent lowers natural language into the contract, an HTML Agent renders the contract as persistent structured HTML, and a Hardware-in-the-Loop Agent implements and revises the design with measured evidence. We evaluate ContractHIL-HLS in two parts. On 94 locally executable HLS-Eval tasks, the structured contract provides the largest small design gain, improving the estimated single-sample testbench pass rate from 64.0% to 70.2%; the full flow reaches 70.4% pass@1 and 76.6% pass@5. Because HLS-Eval does not exercise board-level design, we also validate ContractHIL-HLS on a board tested ML-KEM/ML-DSA post-quantum cryptography (PQC) secure-message accelerator, where the retained dual-bitstream organization reduces six-message average text runtime from 207.3 ms to 52.4 ms with positive routed WNS on both images while preserving decrypted-message verification. We open-source our work at BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS (https://github.com/BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS).
title_zh: ContractHIL-HLS：面向HLS设计的合约对齐多智能体工作流与硬件在环反馈
abstract_zh: 本文提出了ContractHIL-HLS，一种面向实际高层次综合（HLS）工程的合约对齐多智能体工作流。该工作流包含三项贡献：首先，引入结构化合约作为语义对齐与任务执行工件，将自然语言需求转化为明确的接口、约束、验证检查和回滚规则；其次，通过将HLS、Vivado、PYNQ运行时、功耗及故障证据反馈至生成过程，将硬件信息纳入反馈回路，从而把LLM辅助的HLS从内核代码扩展到系统级和板级闭环；第三，按语义降级与执行任务而非对话角色分解智能体：合约智能体将自然语言降级为合约，HTML智能体将合约渲染为持久化的结构化HTML，硬件在环智能体利用实测证据实现并修正设计。我们从两部分评估ContractHIL-HLS：在94个本地可执行的HLS-Eval任务上，结构化合约带来了最大的小型设计增益，将预估单样本测试台通过率从64.0%提升至70.2%；完整流程达到70.4%的pass@1和76.6%的pass@5。由于HLS-Eval不涉及板级设计，我们还在经过板级测试的ML-KEM/ML-DSA后量子密码（PQC）安全消息加速器上验证了ContractHIL-HLS，其中保留的双比特流组织将六条消息的平均文本运行时间从207.3毫秒降至52.4毫秒，两个镜像的正布线负时序裕量（WNS）均保持正值，同时保留了解密消息验证功能。我们已在BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS（https://github.com/BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS）开源了该工作。

title: RepoReasoner: Evaluating Repository-Level Code Reasoning Ability of Long-Context Language Models
authors: Yanlin Wang, Suiquan Wang, Yanli Wang, Bowen Zhang, Daya Guo, Jiachi Chen, Zibin Zheng
publish: arXiv
abstract: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering tasks, yet most existing benchmarks evaluate code reasoning at the function level, where all relevant information is localized. This setting fails to reflect real-world development, which requires reasoning across multiple files and complex dependency structures. We introduce RepoReasoner, a benchmark for evaluating repository-level code reasoning. It assesses two complementary abilities: Output Prediction, which measures fine-grained, stateful execution reasoning across files, and Call Chain Prediction, which evaluates high-level architectural dependency understanding under noisy context. Our benchmark is constructed through a multi-stage pipeline that leverages dynamic tracing of pytest executions to obtain ground-truth call chains, along with LLM-based I/O rewriting to reduce memorization effects. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art LLMs. Even under oracle context, the best-performing model achieves only 69.1% Pass@1 on Output Prediction, indicating that cross-file reasoning remains a major challenge. In Call Chain Prediction, models exhibit high precision but low recall, suggesting limited multi-hop dependency understanding. Furthermore, performance drops on rewritten data reveal partial reliance on memorization, and longer contexts do not consistently improve results due to noise. These findings highlight fundamental limitations in current LLMs' repository-level reasoning and motivate future work on structured architectural understanding and cross-file inference.
title_zh: RepoReasoner：评估长上下文语言模型的仓库级代码推理能力
abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型在软件工程任务中展现出强大性能，但现有基准测试大多在函数级别评估代码推理能力，所有相关信息均局限于局部范围内。这种设定难以反映真实开发场景，后者需要跨多个文件和复杂依赖结构进行推理。我们提出RepoReasoner——一个用于评估仓库级代码推理的基准测试。它衡量两种互补能力：输出预测（衡量跨文件的细粒度、有状态执行推理）以及调用链预测（在噪声上下文中评估高层架构依赖理解能力）。本基准通过多阶段流程构建，利用pytest执行的动态追踪获取真实调用链，并采用基于大语言模型的输入输出改写来降低记忆效应。我们评估了七种最先进的大语言模型。即便在理想上下文条件下，表现最佳的模型在输出预测任务中仅达到69.1%的Pass@1，表明跨文件推理仍是一大挑战。在调用链预测中，模型显示出高精确率但低召回率，反映出对多跳依赖理解能力有限。此外，在改写数据上的性能下降揭示了部分依赖记忆效应的现象，而更长的上下文由于噪声问题并未持续提升结果。这些发现揭示了当前大语言模型在仓库级推理上存在根本性局限，并推动未来在结构化架构理解与跨文件推理方面的研究。

title: Specula: Scaling formal specifications for autonomous model checking of system code
authors: Qian Cheng, Saad Mohammad Rafid Pial, Ruize Tang, Yiming Su, Emilie Ma, Finn Hackett, Ivan Beschastnikh, Yu Huang, Tianyin Xu
publish: arXiv
abstract: Specula is a push-button agentic system that generates high-quality formal specifications for large, complex system code and uses the specifications for highly effective model checking and bug finding. Specula employs large language model (LLM) based coding agents to autonomously develop TLA+ specifications, including invariants that describe correctness properties of the target system and formal models that describe the system implementation with the right level of abstractions. Specula is fully autonomous and thus eliminates the barrier of applying formal methods to real-world system code (as in traditional human-centric approaches). Meanwhile, Specula addresses limitations of LLM-driven techniques like reward hacking and hallucinations through self-evolving loops that iteratively improve specification quality by enabling the agents to deepen their understanding of system code and its behaviors. We have used Specula to check 48 open-source system projects; Specula found 249 bugs including many deep bugs that are hard to find by existing approaches. Specula has been used by several companies and is maintained at https://github.com/specula-org/Specula.
title_zh: Specula: 面向系统代码自主模型检验的形式规约扩展
abstract_zh: Specula 是一种按钮式智能系统，能够为大型、复杂的系统代码生成高质量的形式化规范，并利用这些规范进行高效模型检测和缺陷发现。Specula 采用基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体，自主开发 TLA+ 规范，包括描述目标系统正确性属性的不变量，以及以适当抽象级别描述系统实现的形式化模型。Specula 完全自主运行，从而消除了将形式化方法应用于真实世界系统代码的障碍（相比于传统以人为中心的方法）。同时，Specula 通过自我进化循环解决了 LLM 驱动技术（如奖励黑客和幻觉）的局限性，使智能体能够不断加深对系统代码及其行为的理解，从而迭代提升规范质量。我们使用 Specula 对 48 个开源系统项目进行了检测，发现了 249 个缺陷，其中包括许多现有方法难以发现的深层缺陷。Specula 已被多家公司使用，并在 https://github.com/specula-org/Specula 上维护。

title: ARCHER: Agentic Rule and Compliance Harness for Executable Regulations
authors: Chiraag Singh Anand, Xue Wen Tan, Lionel Teo, Eric Tan
publish: arXiv
abstract: Verifying building compliance requires validating thousands of rules against large Building Information Modeling (BIM) designs, which is laborious, capital-intensive, and unscalable. Existing Automated Compliance Checkers (ACCs) are often difficult to generalize across different scenarios, as they are typically developed for highly specific rule sets and use cases. In addition, many ACCs are proprietary, meaning the underlying verification code is not released to end users, so users cannot verify whether their regulatory intent can be accurately captured. We introduce ARCHER (Agentic Rule and Compliance Harness for Executable Regulations), a test-driven, deterministically orchestrated multi-agent program-synthesis harness that generates auditable verification code from regulatory Codes of Practice, enabling transparent, adaptable, and scalable compliance checking. To characterize what makes agentic synthesis work, we evaluate a taxonomy of six harnesses of increasing agentic sophistication across four backbone models, spanning realistic data-governance tiers (from frontier third-party APIs to a fully on-premise open-weights model) on a novel dataset derived from real-world compliance scenarios. ARCHER's deterministic multi-agent orchestration achieves the highest accuracy for every backbone, improving mean union accuracy by 82% over a naive single-pass prompting baseline. Our cost-accuracy analysis further shows that using the ARCHER harness, a self-hosted open-weights model can reach 97.8% of frontier-API accuracy at a quarter of the cost, making data-sovereign compliance checking practical.
title_zh: ARCHER：面向可执行法规的代理规则与合规框架
abstract_zh: 验证建筑合规性需要针对大型建筑信息模型（BIM）设计验证数千条规则，这一过程费力、资本密集且难以扩展。现有的自动化合规检查器（ACC）通常难以在不同场景中泛化，因为它们通常针对高度特定的规则集和用例开发。此外，许多ACC是专有的，意味着底层验证代码不会向最终用户公开，因此用户无法验证其监管意图是否被准确捕捉。我们提出ARCHER（可执行法规的代理规则与合规框架），这是一个基于测试驱动、确定性编排的多智能体程序合成框架，能够从法规实践规范生成可审计的验证代码，从而实现透明、自适应且可扩展的合规检查。为了刻画智能体合成的有效机制，我们评估了六种不同智能体复杂度的框架分类，在四种骨干模型上（涵盖现实数据治理层级，从顶尖第三方API到完全本地部署的开源权重模型），基于一个源自真实合规场景的新数据集进行测试。ARCHER的确定性多智能体编排在每个骨干模型上都实现了最高准确率，相较于简单的单次提示基线，平均联合准确率提升了82%。我们的成本-准确率分析进一步表明，使用ARCHER框架，自托管开源权重模型可以以四分之一成本达到顶尖API准确率的97.8%，使得数据主权合规检查变得可行。

title: RIDGE: An Autonomous Framework for Validation and Method Discovery in LLM-Generated Option Pricing
authors: Liexin Cheng, Xue Cheng, Shuaiqiang Liu, Cornelis W. Oosterlee
publish: arXiv
abstract: Automated code generation is becoming an important tool in quantitative finance, where large language models can generate option pricing implementations directly from mathematical model specifications. Validating such implementations, however, requires considerably more than conventional software testing: numerical pricing methods must remain mathematically consistent, numerically stable, and reliable across a wide range of model parameters. We introduce RIDGE, an autonomous validation framework in which generated pricing implementations are subjected to structured no-arbitrage tests, stress tests, benchmark comparisons, and consistency checks. Validation evidence is interpreted diagnostically, while the resulting knowledge is accumulated in a repository and reused across models and successive validation iterations. This enables systematic refinement of both the pricing implementation and the validation methodology. The framework is applied to five stochastic volatility models. Across these studies, all detected implementation defects are removed and, in two cases, the validation process itself leads to new semi-analytic pricing methodologies. The supplementary material is available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/ShQiangLiu/ridge.
title_zh: RIDGE：一种用于LLM生成期权定价验证和方法发现的自主框架
abstract_zh: 自动化代码生成正成为量化金融中的重要工具，大语言模型能够根据数学模型规范直接生成期权定价实现。然而，验证这些实现比传统软件测试需要更多考量：数值定价方法必须在广泛的模型参数范围内保持数学一致性、数值稳定性及可靠性。我们提出RIDGE这一自主验证框架，通过对生成的定价实现进行结构化无套利测试、压力测试、基准比较及一致性检验，实现验证过程。验证结果以诊断方式解释，产生的知识积累于存储库中，并在不同模型及后续验证迭代中重复使用。这能够系统性地改进定价实现和验证方法论。该框架已应用于五个随机波动率模型。在这些研究中，所有检测到的实现缺陷均被消除，且有两个案例中，验证过程本身催生了新的半解析定价方法。补充材料可见于GitHub仓库：https://github.com/ShQiangLiu/ridge。

title: SkillGate: Cost Efficient Runtime Malicious Skill File Detection in Coding Agents
authors: Rui Yang, Michael Fu, Kla Tantithamthavorn, Chetan Arora, Joey Chua
publish: arXiv
abstract: Software engineering teams now deploy AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as first-class productivity tools, installing domain-specific skill files to tailor agent behavior to project APIs, framework conventions, and organizational workflows. These complex Markdown files are easily downloaded from public registries with a single npx skills add command and no real security screening, representing a novel supply-chain attack surface: a malicious skill file can silently reprogram agent behavior, exfiltrating credentials, injecting backdoors into generated code, or redirecting agent actions to attacker-controlled endpoints. The threat is not hypothetical: recent reports document hundreds of malicious skill packages in public registries, including organized campaigns that distributed credential-stealing infostealers via fake productivity skills. No systematic toolchain defense exists for this attack surface. We present SkillGate, a deployable security gateway that screens AI skill packages before coding agent installation. SkillGate uses a hybrid regex-prefilter + LLM-judge pipeline: safe-signal files bypass the LLM entirely (skip savings); flagged files have only their matched snippet windows sent to the judge, not the full content (snippet savings). We answer four research questions covering detection effectiveness, screening cost, runtime overhead, and false positive behavior on the SkillsBench benchmark against two existing tools. On SkillsBench (n=1,650, 9.1% malicious), SkillGate achieves F1=0.817, FPR=1.13% while reducing LLM input tokens by 77% vs. full-file screening, and outperforming existing tools by 5-6x on threshold-independent AUPRC (0.830 vs. 0.144/0.162).
title_zh: SkillGate：编码代理中成本高效的运行时恶意技能文件检测
abstract_zh: 软件工程团队现在将AI编码代理（如Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot）作为一流的生产力工具进行部署，通过安装特定领域的技能文件来定制代理行为以适应项目API、框架惯例和组织工作流。这些复杂的Markdown文件可以通过一条简单的`npx skills add`命令从公共注册表中轻松下载，且未经真正的安全审查，从而构成了一种新型的供应链攻击面：恶意技能文件可以静默地重新编程代理行为，窃取凭证、向生成的代码注入后门，或将代理操作重定向到攻击者控制的端点。这种威胁并非假设：最近的报告记录了公共注册表中存在数百个恶意技能包，包括有组织的攻击活动通过伪造的生产力技能分发窃取凭证的信息窃取程序。目前针对这一攻击面尚无系统化的工具链防御措施。我们提出了SkillGate，这是一个可部署的安全网关，在编码代理安装之前对AI技能包进行筛选。SkillGate采用混合的正则表达式预过滤器加大语言模型（LLM）评判器的流水线：安全信号文件完全绕过LLM（跳过处理），而被标记的文件仅将其匹配到的片段窗口发送给评判器，而非完整内容（片段节省）。我们针对SkillsBench基准（n=1,650，其中9.1%为恶意），通过与两个现有工具对比，回答了四个研究问题，涵盖检测有效性、筛选成本、运行时开销和误报行为。在SkillsBench上，SkillGate取得了F1=0.817、误报率（FPR）=1.13%的性能，同时将LLM输入令牌数量相比完整文件筛选减少了77%，在阈值无关的AUPRC指标上以5-6倍的幅度超越现有工具（0.830对比0.144/0.162）。

title: LLM4OSC: Profile-Bound Natural Language Control with Deterministic Validation for Open Sound Control
authors: Yuan-Yi Fan
publish: arXiv
abstract: Open Sound Control (OSC) is the dominant wire protocol for real-time parametric control in professional audio, live performance, and virtual production. Large language models can emit plausible OSC, but they hallucinate addresses, mishandle type tags, and fail under paraphrase- unacceptable in show-critical contexts. We present LLM4OSC, a local-first architecture in which models propose structured intent JSON over a human-reviewed device profile, and deterministic code validates, clamps, and encodes before any UDP send. We introduce a frozen evaluation harness with CI gates on wrong-send rate: mismatches that would still pass validation and transmit. On a Max/MSP hero profile (12 patterns; 8 literal + 8 paraphrase + 4 refusal cases), after profile tag enrichment, symbolic slot fill, NL refine, and a retrieval confidence gate, backends B0--B3 all pass frozen gates (100% semantic accuracy, 0% wrong-send). B0 (rules) remains the production default at ~0.05ms; LLM backends remain ~3-4s. Historical few-shot B2 accuracy of 62.5% rises to 100% on this suite only after symbolic post-processing- not because the 0.5B model alone becomes show-safe. We argue for propose-validate-send and wrong-send rate as first-class metrics for language-to-control systems.
title_zh: LLM4OSC：基于配置文件绑定的自然语言控制与确定性子验证在开放声音控制中的应用
abstract_zh: Open Sound Control (OSC) 是专业音频、现场表演和虚拟制作中实时参数控制的主流线协议。大语言模型能够生成看似合理的OSC指令，但它们会编造地址、错误处理类型标记，并在同义改写时出错——这在演出关键场景中是不可接受的。我们提出LLM4OSC，一种本地优先架构，其中模型通过人工审核的设备配置文件提出结构化意图JSON，而确定性代码在UDP发送前进行验证、约束和编码。我们引入了一个冻结的评估框架，并设置持续集成门控依据错误发送率：即那些仍能通过验证并传输的误匹配。在Max/MSP英雄配置文件上（12个模式；8个字面+8个同义改写+4个拒绝案例），经过配置文件标签增强、符号化槽填充、自然语言精炼和检索置信度门控后，后端B0至B3均通过冻结门控（100%语义准确率，0%错误发送率）。B0（基于规则）仍以约0.05ms延迟作为生产默认选择；LLM后端延迟约为3-4秒。历史小样本学习下B2的62.5%准确率，仅在此测试套件中经过符号化后处理后才提升至100%——但这并非因为0.5B模型本身变得演出安全。我们主张将“提议-验证-发送”流程和错误发送率作为语言到控制系统的一级指标。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Code Optimization
authors: Pierre Chambon, Kunhao Zheng, Juliette Decugis, Benoit Sagot, Gabriel Synnaeve
publish: arXiv
abstract: RL for code correctness is now established: have the model generate a program, run it against hidden test cases, and reward solutions that pass. Extending this to code optimization seems straightforward: just add execution time to the reward. But in practice, once timing drives the reward, small problems in measurement noise, reward sparsity, or GRPO instability overwhelm the signal and make RL fail: generated solutions are barely faster, and more of them can fail. We make execution time learnable through three stages: (1) how code is tested, by building DMC-Optim with large optimization tests and a calibrated sandbox; (2) how speed is turned into reward, by composing correctness and speed in the RL environment and using an offline simulator to predict the most promising configurations; and (3) how the model learns from that reward, by adapting GRPO and evaluation to the sparser, noisier timed-execution setting. On DMC-Optim, the strongest optimization-aware configurations improve strict top-50% pass@1 from 18.0% to 31.3% on Qwen 2.5 7B and from 30.7% to 50.4% on CWM 32B. These gains further increase at stricter percentiles such as top-30%, with 125% relative improvement for CWM 32B, while preserving pure-correctness scores. When the timing sandbox is degraded, robust optimization RL reaches 100% to 200% improvement over standard RLVR, depending on the evaluation criterion. On LCB, CWM 32B wins up to 83% of median-sample speed comparisons against standard RLVR. Relative to the fastest correct human submissions per problem, it reaches about half the human rate of complexity-class improvements (14% vs. 28%).
title_zh: 面向代码优化的强化学习
abstract_zh: 针对代码正确性的强化学习现已成熟：让模型生成程序，在隐藏测试用例上运行，并对通过测试的方案给予奖励。将其扩展到代码优化似乎直截了当：只需将执行时间加入奖励函数。但在实践中，一旦执行时间驱动奖励，测量噪声、奖励稀疏性或GRPO不稳定等小问题就会淹没信号，导致强化学习失败：生成的解决方案几乎没有提速，且更多方案会失败。我们通过三个阶段使执行时间变得可学习：（1）代码测试方式——构建DMC-Optim，配备大规模优化测试用例和校准后的沙盒环境；（2）速度转换为奖励的方式——在强化学习环境中组合正确性与速度，并使用离线模拟器预测最有潜力的配置；（3）模型从该奖励中学习的方式——通过调整GRPO和评估策略，使其适应更稀疏、更嘈杂的定时执行场景。在DMC-Optim上，最强的优化感知配置将严格的前50%通过率@1从18.0%提升至31.3%（Qwen 2.5 7B），并从30.7%提升至50.4%（CWM 32B）。在更严格的百分位（如前30%）上，这些收益进一步增加，CWM 32B的相对提升达到125%，同时保持了纯正确性分数。当定时沙盒环境降级时，鲁棒的优化强化学习相比标准RLVR实现了100%至200%的提升（取决于评估标准）。在LCB上，CWM 32B在中位数样本速度比较中相较于标准RLVR胜出高达83%。相对于每个问题中最快的人类正确提交，它在复杂度类改进率上达到约人类的一半（14%对比28%）。

title: VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning
authors: Jiaxin Bai, Jiaxuan Xiong
publish: arXiv
abstract: Different research lines use the term world model in different ways, yet they share a common aim: to capture how the world evolves under action in a form that supports perception, simulation, and planning. Two prominent realizations are neural predictors that learn dynamics in continuous vector spaces, and hand-built physics engines that expose explicit state and physical laws. Neural predictors scale from data but leave the form of the dynamics implicit; physics engines are inspectable and editable but difficult to construct at scale. We introduce VisualPatchWorld (VPW), which represents world dynamics as code. VPW first selects a qualitative dynamical form with short active probes, then fits that form's free parameters from recorded state-action traces by minimizing multi-step prediction error. The resulting programs can be rolled forward like a simulator, inspected in source form, and used inside model-predictive control; image-derived scene graphs can supply the live state at replan time. Across comparisons with prior code-based world models, VPW attains 69.0% mean planning success and exceeds the strongest code baseline by 23.5 points. The largest gains arise when choosing the correct qualitative dynamics is essential. Under the same planner, the induced models approach ground-truth engine success on navigation and grasp-rich control; a residual gap remains for contact-rich pushing, and checking a shortlist of promising plans in the engine closes most of that gap. These results establish a practical route toward automatically constructed code world models that are useful for planning. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/VisualPatchWorld/.
title_zh: VisualPatchWorld：将代码世界模型作为规划中的潜在结构化表示
abstract_zh: 不同研究路线对“世界模型”一词的使用方式各异，但它们共同的目标是：捕捉世界在行动作用下如何演化，以支撑感知、模拟与规划。两种典型的实现方式为：在连续向量空间中学习动力学的神经预测器，以及显式定义状态与物理定律的手工构建物理引擎。神经预测器可从数据中扩展，但将动力学形式隐式化；物理引擎虽可检查与编辑，却难以大规模构建。我们提出VisualPatchWorld（VPW），将世界动力学表示为代码。VPW首先通过短时主动探测选择定性的动力学形式，随后从记录的状态-动作轨迹中，通过最小化多步预测误差来拟合该形式的自由参数。生成的程序可像模拟器一样前向推演，能以源代码形式检查，并用于模型预测控制；图像派生的场景图可在重新规划时提供实时状态。与先前基于代码的世界模型相比，VPW实现了69.0%的平均规划成功率，比最强代码基线高出23.5个百分点。当选择正确的定性动力学至关重要时，改进最为显著。在相同规划器下，诱导模型在导航与抓取密集型控制中接近真实引擎的成功率；在接触丰富的推动任务中仍存在残余差距，而通过引擎检查少数有前景的规划方案，可基本弥合这一差距。这些结果为实现自动构建对规划有用的代码世界模型提供了实用路径。代码详见 https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/VisualPatchWorld/。

title: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
authors: Zhongming Yu, Hengjia Yu, Boqin Yuan, Shuting Zhao, Yizhao Chen, Aryan Dokania, Mihir Jagtap, Jiayu Chang, Yitong Ma, Yash Jayswal, Wentao Ni, Hejia Zhang, Zhaoling Chen, Gangda Deng, Jishen Zhao
publish: arXiv
abstract: Coding agents repeatedly search, navigate, and retain context from evolving repositories, but disconnected indexes, language servers, and task-local histories force repeated discovery and obscure lifecycle costs. CodeNib builds reusable lexical, dense, and structural views per repository commit, maps outputs to repository-relative source ranges, maintains selected views across edits, and serves ranked search, symbol navigation, and bounded context through one runtime. Across 100 snapshots, we map quality-cost frontiers across the repository-context lifecycle. When outputs match an independent rebuild, graph and vector updates are $8.7\times$ and $25.4\times$ faster at the median. On the static-navigation subset matching normalized live-server locations (63% of 1,000 requests), the median per-request live/static latency ratio is $4.7\times$. Across five models, selected context policies preserve localization with 50--87% fewer trajectory tokens than paired grep/read. Together, these results support multi-view repository-context serving with explicit, operation-specific validity boundaries.
title_zh: CodeNib: 一个用于为编码代理提供仓库上下文的多视图数据系统
abstract_zh: 编程智能体持续搜索、导航并从不断演化的代码仓库中保留上下文，但断开连接的索引、语言服务器以及任务本地历史迫使重复发现并掩盖生命周期成本。CodeNib 针对每个仓库提交构建可复用的词法、稠密和结构视图，将输出映射到仓库相对源码范围，在编辑过程中维护所选视图，并通过单个运行时提供排序搜索、符号导航和有限上下文。在 100 个快照中，我们绘制了仓库上下文生命周期中的质量-成本边界。当输出匹配独立重建时，图更新和向量更新的中位数速度分别提升 8.7 倍和 25.4 倍。在静态导航子集（匹配标准化实时服务器位置，占 1000 次请求的 63%）中，每次请求的实时/静态延迟比中位数为 4.7 倍。在五个模型上，选定上下文策略比配对的 grep/read 方法减少 50%–87% 的轨迹令牌，同时保留定位能力。综合这些结果，支持了具有显式、操作特定有效性边界的多视图仓库上下文服务。

title: Does Runtime Topology Context Improve LLM-Generated Kubernetes Security Patches?
authors: Farooq Shaikh
publish: arXiv
abstract: Kubernetes is central to the cloud-native ecosystem, orchestrating containerised workloads. Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can automate cluster security remediation, generating configuration patches from Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) findings without human authoring. Such systems, however, prompt the model with each finding in isolation from the live service call graph, assuming general hardening knowledge suffices. This assumption breaks down whenever a patch must preserve a runtime service dependency invisible to the model: an otherwise compliant fix then carries a destructive functional blast radius, crashing downstream callers or silently severing call edges across the cluster. Whether live cluster context improves patch correctness has not been measured under controlled conditions across multiple dependency classes. We introduce KuTIE (Kubernetes Topology Intelligence Engine), which builds a live cluster context from Istio call edges, Trivy KSPM findings, and the service-account bindings a workload reads, and conditions LLM patch generation on it. It is evaluated on VulnCare, a purpose-built 36-deployment, four-namespace healthcare cluster with 31 injectable findings across seven dependency classes, each labelled by topology dependence against cluster ground truth. Across 248 trials, topology context raises topology-dependent patch correctness from 11.1% to 78.0% ($Δ= 0.669$), a gap that holds for every model and for six of seven classes, from credential and network-policy ($Δ= 0.95$) to role-based access control ($Δ= 0.31$); a topology-independent control exhibits no such effect ($Δ= 0.0$), isolating the result from generic prompt enrichment. Supplying the live service-call graph and the service-account bindings it exposes thus improves remediation of topology-dependent findings well beyond scanner-only context.
title_zh: 运行时拓扑上下文能否改善LLM生成的Kubernetes安全补丁？
abstract_zh: Kubernetes是云原生生态系统的核心，负责编排容器化工作负载。近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）能够自动化集群安全修复，基于Kubernetes安全态势管理（KSPM）的发现结果生成配置补丁，无需人工编写。然而，此类系统每次仅将单个发现结果孤立地输入模型，忽略了实时服务调用图，假设通用的加固知识已足够。这一假设在需要保留模型不可见的运行时服务依赖时失效：本应合规的修复会带来毁灭性的功能波及范围，导致下游调用者崩溃，或悄然切断集群内的调用边。在受控条件下，不同依赖类别的集群实时上下文是否提升补丁正确性尚未得到衡量。我们引入KuTIE（Kubernetes拓扑智能引擎），该引擎基于Istio调用边、Trivy KSPM发现结果以及工作负载读取的服务账户绑定构建实时集群上下文，并以此作为LLM补丁生成的条件。我们在VulnCare上对其进行评估，这是一个专门构建的医疗集群，包含36个部署、4个命名空间，涉及7个依赖类别的31个可注入发现项，每个发现项均基于集群真实情况标注了拓扑依赖关系。经过248次试验，拓扑上下文将拓扑依赖补丁的正确率从11.1%提升至78.0%（Δ=0.669），这一差距在所有模型和七个类别中的六个中均成立，从凭证和网络策略（Δ=0.95）到基于角色的访问控制（Δ=0.31）；而拓扑无关的对照组未表现出此类效应（Δ=0.0），这隔离了结果与通用提示增强的关联。因此，提供实时服务调用图及其暴露的服务账户绑定，可显著提升拓扑依赖发现项的修复效果，远超仅依赖扫描器上下文的方式。

title: KQFuzz: Knowledge-Guided Fuzzing for Quantum Libraries via Large Language Models
authors: Fuyuan Xia, Qixin Zhang, Chenhao Ying, Haojin Zhu, Shuai Wang, Yuan Luo, Pingchuan Ma, Yuxuan Du
publish: arXiv
abstract: As quantum computing continually improves, ensuring the reliability and correctness of quantum libraries has become increasingly critical. To this end, many LLM-based fuzzing approaches towards quantum libraries have been proposed to uncover potential bugs. However, these methods still suffer from limitations such as insufficient flexibility and low efficiency, which hinder the progress of the quantum computing field. To address these challenges, we propose KQFuzz, a novel knowledge-guided fuzzer for quantum libraries. It leverages comprehensive codebase knowledge to ground LLM-based test generation, synergizing this with fitness-guided evaluation and two-level mutations to explore complex execution paths and trigger potential bugs. Firstly, KQFuzz introduces a novel prompting scheme tailored to quantum programs, which strategically incorporates knowledge of the codebase to efficiently generate high-quality quantum seed programs. Moreover, we develop evaluation and mutation strategies to handle the generated seed programs, facilitating efficient fuzzing execution while further enriching the diversity of the resulting test cases. We implement KQFuzz and conduct fuzzing on three popular quantum libraries, including Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, with coverage improved by up to 18.44%. During the development of KQFuzz, we discovered 13 bugs, all of which have been confirmed and 12 have already been fixed by the developers.
title_zh: KQFuzz：通过大语言模型对量子库进行知识引导的模糊测试
abstract_zh: 随着量子计算技术的不断进步，确保量子库的可靠性和正确性变得愈发关键。为此，研究者提出了多种基于大语言模型（LLM）的量子库模糊测试方法，以发现潜在缺陷。然而，现有方法仍存在灵活性不足、效率低下等局限，阻碍了量子计算领域的发展。针对这些挑战，我们提出KQFuzz——一种面向量子库的新型知识引导式模糊测试工具。它通过利用全面的代码库知识来指导基于LLM的测试用例生成，并结合适应度引导评估与两级变异策略，探索复杂执行路径并触发潜在缺陷。首先，KQFuzz引入了一种专为量子程序设计的新型提示方案，该方案策略性地融入代码库知识，高效生成高质量量子种子程序。其次，我们开发了评估与变异策略来处理生成的种子程序，在提升模糊测试执行效率的同时，进一步丰富测试用例的多样性。我们实现了KQFuzz，并对包括Qiskit、PennyLane和Cirq在内的三个主流量子库进行了模糊测试。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于其他最先进的方法，覆盖率最高提升18.44%。在KQFuzz开发过程中，我们发现了13个缺陷，这些缺陷均已得到确认，其中12个已被开发者修复。

title: Towards Bottom-Up Enumeration in miniKanren via Pruning and Memoization
authors: Nikolai Kudasov
publish: arXiv
abstract: We present two small library combinators on top of plain miniKanren, designed to bring bottom-up enumeration with observational deduplication, the standard tool in non-relational program-by-example (PBE) synthesizers, into the relational setting. The first combinator, prune, deduplicates an answer stream by a user-supplied key, typically the input/output behavior of the candidate. The second, defrel/bank, memoizes a relation against canonical fresh variables so that a single pruned answer stream is built bottom-up and replayed at every call site. We also discuss a weighted variant, defrel/bank-w, which attaches admissible upper bounds to immature streams to recover best-first enumeration in cases where the natural depth-first canonical order misses compact representatives. On a preliminary PBE benchmark of arithmetic and string synthesis targets, defrel/bank substantially outperforms the depth-bounded baseline on most deep targets, while losing on a small family where the canonical depth-first enumeration order misses compact representatives. We leave a broader empirical evaluation to an extended version of this paper.
title_zh: 通过剪枝与记忆化实现miniKanren中的自底向上枚举
abstract_zh: 我们提出了两个基于纯miniKanren的小型库组合子，旨在将自底向上枚举与观察去重（非关系型示例编程（PBE）合成器中的标准工具）引入关系型设定中。第一个组合子prune通过用户提供的键（通常是候选者的输入/输出行为）对答案流进行去重。第二个组合子defrel/bank根据规范新变量记忆化一个关系，使得单个剪枝后的答案流被自底向上构建并在每个调用点重放。我们还讨论了一个加权变体defrel/bank-w，该变体为不成熟流附加允许的上界，以在自然深度优先规范顺序遗漏紧凑代表的情况下恢复最佳优先枚举。在算术和字符串合成目标的初步PBE基准测试中，defrel/bank在大多数深层目标上显著优于深度限界基线，但在一个小族上表现较差，因为规范的深度优先枚举顺序遗漏了紧凑代表。我们将更广泛的实证评估留给本文的扩展版本。

title: SecDrift: Measuring Sector-Conditioned Security Drift in AI-Generated Code
authors: Narayanaswami Natraj Bharadwaj, Dhivya Chandramouleeswaran
publish: arXiv
abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for code generation in critical infrastructure, yet the security effect of domain-specific prompting is understudied. We present SecDrift, a benchmark measuring sector-conditioned security drift: the change in static-analysis vulnerability rates when prompts are conditioned on industry contexts versus neutral baselines. We evaluate 7 LLMs (6 producing analyzable code) across 8 CISA critical infrastructure sectors and 9 CWE categories with 5 replicates (5,355 evaluations), using a 5-dimension transformation with a matched-baseline condition that holds the task fixed while substituting only domain terminology. Industry prompts naively appear more secure (14.0% vs. 11.4%, -2.7pp), but the gap is not statistically significant (Fisher's exact p = 0.24, Cohen's h = -0.08) and is a composition artifact of two CWE categories: excluding CWE-502 and CWE-22 eliminates and slightly reverses it (+0.4pp, p = 1.00). A mixed-effects logistic regression confirms sector identity is not a moderator and localizes the only detectable condition effect to those two vulnerability types. 0 of 8 sectors show drift distinguishable from baseline, corrected or uncorrected (|h| < 0.15). A placebo on two non-CISA sectors (e-commerce, online education) reproduces the CISA industry rate almost exactly (10.5% vs. 11.4%, p = 0.63): the small pooled pattern reflects generic industry-framing specificity, not critical-infrastructure identity. In contrast, model selection has a large and consistent effect: among full-output models vulnerability rates range from 11.6% to 16.1%, and these differences persist across conditions. Model choice, not prompt framing, is the more reliable security lever. We release the framework, prompts, generated code, findings, human-validation verdicts, and analysis scripts.
title_zh: SecDrift：测量AI生成代码中基于行业条件的安全漂移
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于关键基础设施中的代码生成，然而，针对特定领域提示的安全效果尚缺乏研究。我们提出了SecDrift基准，用于衡量行业条件化安全漂移：即当提示在行业背景下与中性基线条件下相比时，静态分析漏洞率的变化。我们在8个CISA关键基础设施行业和9个CWE类别中评估了7个LLM（其中6个生成可分析代码），进行了5次重复实验（总计5,355次评估），采用五维度变换方法，并设置匹配基线条件，即固定任务不变，仅替换领域术语。行业提示在表面上似乎更安全（14.0% vs. 11.4%，下降2.7个百分点），但该差异在统计上不显著（Fisher精确检验p=0.24，Cohen's h=-0.08），且是两种CWE类别的组成假象：排除CWE-502和CWE-22后，该差异消失并轻微反转（+0.4个百分点，p=1.00）。混合效应逻辑回归确认，行业身份并非调节变量，并将唯一可检测的条件效应定位到这两种漏洞类型。8个行业中有0个行业的漂移与基线可区分（无论是否校正，|h| < 0.15）。针对两个非CISA行业（电子商务、在线教育）进行的安慰剂测试，几乎精确复现了CISA行业的漏洞率（10.5% vs. 11.4%，p=0.63）：这一较小的汇总模式反映了通用行业框架的具体性，而非关键基础设施的身份特征。相比之下，模型选择具有显著且持续的影响：在完整输出模型中，漏洞率从11.6%到16.1%不等，且这些差异在不同条件下均保持稳定。因此，模型选择而非提示框架，是更可靠的安全杠杆。我们公开了框架、提示、生成的代码、研究发现、人工验证结果以及分析脚本。

title: Who is scientific code for? Maintaining human-readable landmarks in agent-written code
authors: Elle O'Brien
publish: arXiv
abstract: Scientific research involving code has long rested on the assumption that at least one person understands why the code exists. As scientists adopt coding agents, this assumption is breaking down. Drawing on an ongoing contextual inquiry of scientific programmers working with agentic tools (four cases to date), a survey of over 800 scientific programmers, and my own analysis workflows, this position piece describes how scientists are inventing personal conventions, "landmarking strategies", for marking which artifacts in a codebase are meant for human understanding and which are context for agents. They repurpose shared infrastructure (version control especially) in idiosyncratic ways, and I argue that this quiet de-standardization could complicate collaboration in teams with heterogeneous software practices. Alternatively, teams that explicitly delineate what is human-readable versus agent context will be better able to develop, document, and maintain scientific code.
title_zh: 科学代码是为谁写的？在智能体编写的代码中保持人类可读的标记。
abstract_zh: 涉及代码的科学研究长期以来一直基于一个假设：至少有一人理解代码存在的原因。随着科学家开始使用编码代理，这一假设正在瓦解。基于一项针对使用代理工具的科研程序员的持续情境调查（迄今四个案例）、一项覆盖超过800名科研程序员的调查以及我个人的分析工作流程，本立场文章描述了科学家如何发明个人惯例（即“地标策略”），用于标记代码库中哪些构件旨在供人类理解，哪些是给代理的上下文。他们以独特的方式重新利用共享基础设施（尤其是版本控制），我认为这种悄然发生的去标准化可能会使具有不同软件实践背景的团队中的协作复杂化。另一方面，明确区分人类可读内容与代理上下文的团队将能够更好地开发、记录和维护科学代码。

title: How Do LLMs Read Bug Reports? An Empirical Study of Attention in LLMs for Automated Program Repair
authors: Ramtin Ehsani, Irene Manotas, Saurabh Pujar, Luca Buratti, Preetha Chatterjee
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based Automated Program Repair systems are advancing rapidly, yet their performance remains inconsistent. Even when provided with the same contextual information, an LLM may generate a correct patch for one bug but fail on another closely related bug. Why this happens remains poorly understood, and it is unclear how LLMs prioritize the diverse information in bug reports and whether model attention affects repair success. In this paper, we present the first empirical study of attention patterns in LLM-based program repair, providing interpretable insights into how models process bug reports and where their attention is concentrated during repair. We analyze 319 real-world Python and Java bugs from SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench to study (RQ1) how model attention is distributed across bug report sections, (RQ2) how attention patterns within each section differ between successful and unsuccessful repairs, and (RQ3) how these patterns compare to information developers consider important for bug fixing. We find that successful repairs are characterized by diffused attention across multiple diagnostic components such as bug descriptions, stacktraces, and test cases, while failures often exhibit over-localized attention toward metadata such as version information. We further observe that stronger alignment between model attention and developer-identified key sections and phrases is associated with higher repair success. Our results provide the first empirical evidence that attention misallocation is a key factor in LLM-based APR failures, and offer actionable insights for designing more interpretable and reliable future APR systems.
title_zh: 大语言模型如何阅读错误报告？针对自动化程序修复中注意力机制的实证研究
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动程序修复系统正在迅速发展，但其性能仍然不稳定。即使在提供相同上下文信息的情况下，LLM可能会为一个漏洞生成正确的补丁，却对另一个密切相关的漏洞失败。为什么会发生这种情况仍然知之甚少，也不清楚LLM如何对错误报告中的多样信息进行优先级排序，以及模型的注意力是否会影响修复成功。在本文中，我们首次对基于LLM的程序修复中的注意力模式进行了实证研究，提供了关于模型如何处理错误报告以及修复过程中注意力集中位置的可解释性见解。我们分析了来自SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench的319个真实世界Python和Java漏洞，研究了（RQ1）模型注意力在错误报告各部分之间是如何分布的，（RQ2）在每部分内成功修复与失败修复的注意力模式有何差异，以及（RQ3）这些模式与开发者认为对修复重要的信息相比如何。我们发现，成功修复的特点在于注意力分散在多个诊断组件上，如漏洞描述、堆栈跟踪和测试用例，而失败则往往表现出对元数据（如版本信息）的过度局部化注意力。我们进一步观察到，模型注意力与开发者识别的关键部分和短语之间的更强对齐与更高的修复成功率相关。我们的结果首次提供了实证证据，表明注意力错配是基于LLM的自动程序修复失败的一个关键因素，并为设计更具可解释性和更可靠的未来自动程序修复系统提供了可操作的见解。

title: Distributing Security Controls Through Harness Engineering
authors: William Robert Gore
publish: arXiv
abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at historic speed, yet security and risk concerns remain the primary barrier to scaling agentic AI across organizations. Existing security controls for coding agents are not systematically distributed to engineering teams, and vendor-native solutions introduce ecosystem dependencies that may not suit every deployment context. This paper investigates whether off-the-shelf security controls can be implemented on commercial AI coding agents and scaled to a distributed user base via a custom agent harness. A phased testing methodology was applied across four agent configurations --- two commercial agents with and without controls, a baseline harness, and a security-hardened harness --- using a 23-test suite derived from the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. SHarD (Secure Harness Distribution), a distributable harness built on the Pi agent harness, demonstrated that three categories of security controls --- OS sandboxing, skill scanning, and tool restriction --- can be embedded and distributed via a single install command while retaining equivalent efficacy to direct installation on commercial agents. SHarD achieved an adjusted score of 100\%, matching the best securely configured commercial agent, with no regression across any test category. Notable observations include evidence that model non-determinism produces inconsistent security outcomes and that autonomous agent behavior can cross system boundaries in ways that OS sandboxing directly mitigates. Initial characteristics toward a control harness fitness framework are proposed, and a third research question is identified for future investigation.
title_zh: 通过线束工程分配安全控制
abstract_zh: AI编码代理正以前所未有的速度被采用，但安全与风险问题仍然是跨组织扩展AI代理的主要障碍。现有的编码代理安全控制措施尚未系统地覆盖工程团队，而供应商原生解决方案引入的生态系统依赖可能并不适用于所有部署场景。本文研究了能否在商业AI编码代理上实施现成的安全控制措施，并通过定制代理控制框架将其扩展至分布式用户群体。研究采用了分阶段测试方法，涉及四种代理配置——两种有无控制的商业代理、一个基础控制框架和一个安全加固框架——并使用基于OWASP代理应用Top 10标准开发的23项测试套件进行评估。SHarD（安全控制框架分发工具）基于Pi代理控制框架构建，展示了操作系统沙箱、技能扫描和工具限制这三类安全控制措施可通过一条安装命令嵌入并分发，同时在性能上与商业代理直接安装的效果相当。SHarD获得了调整后满分100%，与配置最佳的商业代理表现一致，且在所有测试类别中均未出现性能倒退。值得注意的是，研究还发现了模型非确定性导致安全结果不一致的现象，以及自主代理行为可能跨越系统边界，而操作系统沙箱能直接缓解这一问题。本文提出了控制框架适用性评估框架的初步特征，并为未来研究指明了第三个研究方向。

title: Rethinking Training Data for Generating Code Review Comments
authors: Leonardo Centellas-Claros, Estefania Pakarati-Cofre, Juan Pablo Sandoval Alcocer, Diego Elias Costa
publish: arXiv
abstract: Generating code review comments has become a prominent research direction in automated code review, commonly formulated as a text generation task over diff-comment pairs. Despite advances in learning-based approaches, generated review comments are often generic, weakly grounded, or non-actionable. Recent studies have also shown that review comment datasets contain noisy or unsuitable training instances, motivating LLM-based dataset cleaning approaches. In this paper, we argue that problematic training instances are not homogeneous and that some limitations stem from deeper issues in the task formulation itself. Through an empirical inspection of a widely used review comment dataset, we identify misaligned training pairs: instances where the relationship between the code change and the review comment does not provide a reliable learning signal for generating actionable review feedback from localized inputs. We derive a taxonomy of misalignment capturing three recurring sources: semantic ambiguity, lack of actionability, and context dependence. We further explore whether incorporating this taxonomy into LLM-based filtering improves the identification of problematic training instances, observing that detecting misaligned training pairs remains challenging. Based on these observations, we argue that improving review comment generation requires more than dataset cleaning alone, motivating explicit validity criteria, richer contextual inputs, and evaluation practices aligned with review intent and actionability.
title_zh: 重新思考生成代码审查评论的训练数据
abstract_zh: 生成代码审查评论已成为自动化代码审查中的一个重要研究方向，通常被形式化为基于差异-评论对的文本生成任务。尽管基于学习的方法取得了进展，但生成的审查评论往往泛泛而谈、缺乏依据或缺乏可操作性。近期研究还表明，审查评论数据集中包含噪声或不适合的训练实例，这催生了基于大型语言模型的数据集清洗方法。本文认为，有问题的训练实例并非同质化，某些局限性源于任务形式化本身的更深层问题。通过对一个广泛使用的审查评论数据集进行实证检验，我们识别出错位的训练对：即代码变更与审查评论之间的关系无法为从局部输入生成可操作的审查反馈提供可靠学习信号的实例。我们推导出一个错位分类体系，涵盖三种反复出现的来源：语义歧义、缺乏可操作性和上下文依赖性。我们进一步探讨了将这一分类体系纳入基于大型语言模型的过滤是否有助于改进对有问题的训练实例的识别，并观察到检测错位训练对仍具有挑战性。基于这些发现，我们认为改进审查评论生成不仅需要数据集清洗，还需要明确的效度标准、更丰富的上下文输入，以及与审查意图和可操作性相一致的评估实践。

title: Demystifying Deep Learning Compiler Frontend Bugs: An LLM-Aided Empirical Study
authors: Xinyi Yuan, Wei Chen, Jinyi Liu, Pengyu Chen, Jun Wei, Guoquan Wu, Jiaxin Zhu, Tao Huang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Deep learning compilers (DLCs) are designed to translate deep learning programs into optimized, hardware-specific code. Typically, DLC frontends translate programs into graph-based intermediate representations (IRs) to enable optimizations. Defects introduced during this stage (termed \emph{fBug}s) are severe yet understudied, as prior work predominantly focuses on low-level APIs and operators or treats DLCs as monolithic entities. To bridge this gap, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of \emph{fBug}s in TorchDynamo, the default DLC frontend for PyTorch 2, the most popular DL framework. Leveraging a domain-knowledge-enhanced LLM-aided methodology, we analyze 123 \emph{fBug}s and construct a taxonomy comprising 7 root cause categories and 15 subcategories. Our findings provide actionable insights for DLC development and testing. Furthermore, we leverage the LLM to generate targeted, root cause-aware test cases to detect new bugs. We uncovered 23 previously unknown \emph{fBug}s in recent releases (15 confirmed) across eight (sub)categories, demonstrating the efficacy of our methodology in testing and hardening DLC frontends.
title_zh: 揭秘深度学习编译器前端缺陷：一项大语言模型辅助的实证研究
abstract_zh: 深度学习编译器（DLC）旨在将深度学习程序翻译为针对特定硬件优化后的代码。通常，DLC的前端会将程序转换为基于图的中间表示（IR），以便进行优化。在此阶段引入的缺陷（称为\textit{fBug}）虽然严重，但尚未得到充分研究，因为先前的工作主要集中于底层API和算子，或将DLC视为单一实体。为填补这一空白，我们针对TorchDynamo进行了首次系统性实证研究——TorchDynamo是最流行的深度学习框架PyTorch 2的默认DLC前端。借助一种融合领域知识的、由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的方法，我们分析了123个\textit{fBug}，并构建了一个包含7个根因类别和15个子类别的分类体系。我们的研究为DLC的开发与测试提供了可操作的见解。此外，我们利用LLM生成针对性的、根因感知的测试用例来检测新缺陷。我们在近期版本的八个（子）类别中发现了23个先前未知的\textit{fBug}（其中15个已确认），证明了该方法在测试和强化DLC前端方面的有效性。
